from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., Administrative Ruling, Criminal Decision)")
    legal_nature: str | None = Field(description="The overarching legal nature of the case (e.g., Administrative, Civil, Criminal, State Compensation)")
    parties_involved: list[str] | None = Field(description="The key parties, such as Government Body, Individual, Prison, Company")
    dispute_subject: str | None = Field(description="The core legal issue or subject matter of the dispute")
    specific_actions: list[str] | None = Field(description="Specific legal actions or behaviors mentioned (e.g., '不予认定', '强拆', '受贿')")
    key_legal_terms: list[str] | None = Field(description="Terms indicating the case category found in the text")
    anchor_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document anchoring the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
